scope: P8 201 source main glyphs and 812 proposed related words / component-character examples

rules.single_character: Original 158 source readings are historical assertions, not independently verified against an exact authoritative normative source. No reading is approved without original sense and proof.
rules.multi_word: HSK 2021 vocabulary third-party transcription supports discovery, but is not sufficient by itself to approve child-edition printing. Community and automatically concatenated syllables are weaker.
rules.grammar: Separate orthographic word spelling, surface spoken sandhi/neutral tone, per-character teaching reading, and non-independent radical labels. Resolve with real headword sense and authorized Mainland reference.
rules.governance: One independent primary exact-source record, one reviewer and a separate cross-reviewer, and a signed editorial decision are required before a reading can be published.
rules.no_silent_source_fix: Historical v0.5.1 PDF, 201-source stroke steps, and previous P4.5 PDFs are immutable. Any corrected authoritative source is a separate edition.
